description: The plot titled "Hidden State Mean" illustrates the average hidden state mean values across different layers of a model, with three distinct lines representing different conditions. The x-axis is labeled "Layer" and is a linear scale ranging from 0 to 20, with tick labels at intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled "Abs Mean" and is also a linear scale, with tick labels at intervals of 1, ranging from 0 to 4. The blue dashed line represents the "hidden state mean before gate, avg 0.71" and remains relatively flat across the layers, with a slight increase towards the end of the x-axis. The orange dotted line represents the "hidden state mean after gate, avg 0.05" and shows a slight increase as the layers progress. The green solid line represents the "hidden state mean of baseline, avg 0.04" and remains the lowest and most stable across all layers. The plot does not include any peaks, declines, or steady trends beyond the data points provided.
